description: This horizontal bar chart, from the paper "Morphosyntactic probing of multilingual BERT models," illustrates the number of tasks (# tasks) for which each language family achieved performance above a certain threshold, with the horizontal axis representing the count of such tasks ranging from 0 to 80 in linear increments and the vertical axis listing the language families. The bars are sorted in descending order of task count, starting with IE-Slavic at the top. The IE-Slavic family has the longest bar, extending to approximately 79 tasks, followed by IE-Romance at approximately 47 tasks, IE-Germanic at approximately 44 tasks, Uralic at approximately 20 tasks, IE-Baltic at approximately 18 tasks, IE-other at approximately 15 tasks, IE-Indic at approximately 12 tasks, Semitic at approximately 9 tasks, Turkic at approximately 5 tasks, and Basque at approximately 4 tasks. Each bar is colored differently: IE-Slavic is light blue, IE-Romance is dark blue, IE-Germanic is light green, Uralic is dark green, IE-Baltic is pink, IE-other is red, IE-Indic is orange, Semitic is dark orange, Turkic is light purple, and Basque is dark purple. There is no legend, but the categories are labeled on the y-axis. The bars are not annotated with exact values, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their color and length.
